clips.title: The story
paras: Down in the cellar of Thunderbrew Distillery, guard Jarven Thunderbrew finds himself surrounded by barrels he is forbidden to touch. Craving a taste of the family craft, he asks a passing adventurer for a mug of Thunder Ale to help sharpen his wits on duty.

Jarven Thunderbrew is tasked with keeping watch over the deep stores of Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos. Despite being surrounded by the finest stout in Dun Morogh, he works under strict family orders not to dip into the stock while on guard. The temptation proves too much, prompting him to enlist passing travelers to fetch him a pint of potent Thunder Ale from the taps upstairs.

Jarven insists that a good drink will only hone his senses and bolster his watch. Whether indulging a guard on duty is wise remains an open question, but among the hardy dwarves of Dun Morogh, few can fault a Thunderbrew for wanting a taste of his own kin's world-famous brew.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Hmph! There is all this booze down here, but I have strict orders not to touch it. If only I could get a taste of some of our Thunder Ale...that would sharpen my wits, no lying!

clips.title: Completion
paras: For me? You're a true hero, friend!
